notes:
Summary: Retail marketplace focused on mid-to-high-end home goods. Primary search pain: irrelevant results for seasonal catalogs and rising cost of dense reranking. Current infra: Elasticsearch for BM25 + small vector store (self-hosted) for late-stage re-rank; cross-encoder rerank used at top-10 causing high CPU spend. Wants a production-ready RAG pipeline for product search.

Key customer language / call notes:
- 'We need sub-100ms p50 for main queries and p95 under 350ms for most pages — Black Friday acceptable tail can be higher with graceful degradation.'
- 'Cost-per-query must stay under $0.001 for our median query volume or this doesn't pencil.'
- 'Seasonality: up to 8x traffic spikes during promos, need autoscale and predictable unit economics.'

Decision criteria: accuracy uplift vs current BM25, demonstrable cost savings on rerank, clear autoscale/fallback path, SSO + audit controls. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization. Has regulatory note: EU listings must remain in eu-west for residency.

Short fragments / CRM-style bullets:
- POC scope agreed: 1) ingest 1.2M SKU vectors, 2) hybrid search baseline, 3) cheap re-ranker experiment (distilled cross-encoder), 4) cost model for peak vs baseline.
- Security: SOC2 evidence requested; KMS integration needed for Dedicated/VPC.
- Quote request in drive (pricing deck) sent 2026-02-06.
- Internal champion: Head of Search, Lina Gomez — technical and procurement influence.
